ASSIGNMENT,ASSUMPTION,ANDAMENDEDANDRESTATED DECLARATION OFINTERESTANDNOMINEEAGREEMENT This ASSIGNMENT, ASSUMPTION, AND AMENDED AND RESTATED DECLARATIONOFINTERESTANDNOMINEEAGREEMENT(this“Agreement")dated FUND CORPORATION, a New York not-for-profit corporation (the“HDFC"), with an address of c/o Housing Plus Solutions,Inc.,315 Linwood Street,Brooklyn,New York 11208,and SPEQ88 LLC, a New York limited liability Company (the “SPEQ LLC"), with an address of c/o Spatial Equity Co., 447 Broadway, 2"d Floor, New York, New York 10013, and 729 VAN c/o Spatial Equity Co., 447 Broadway, 2nd Floor, New York, New York 10013. WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Declaration of Interest and Nominee Agreement (the "Nominee Agreement"), entered into by and between the HDFC and the SPEQ LLC dated as of October 22, 2025 and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York, Kings County on November 6,2025 as CRFN 2025000301214,the HDFC is the nominalrecord title owner and the SPEQ LLC is the equitable and beneficial owner of that certain real property lying and being in Kings County, the City and State of New York, located at Block 3865, Lot 9, Brooklyn, New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit A, attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Block 9 Property"), and the project proposed to be developed on the Block 9 Property, which was to comprise of one (1) building containing approximately one hundred (100) units of supportive housing and sixty-seven (67) other units, serving formerly homeless women-led households, individuals with severe mental illnesses and/or substance use disorders,veterans, seniors and low-income families (collectively, the “Initial Project”); WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Deed entered into by and between 719 Van Sinderen Corp. as grantor and the HDFC as grantee, dated as of the date hereof and to be recorded in the Office of the City Register, Kings County, the HDFC has since acquired that certain real property lying and being in Kings County, the City and State of New York, located at Block 3865, Lot 21, Brooklyn, New York and as more particularly described in Exhibit B, attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Block 21 Property” and, together with the Block 9 Property,the“Property"); WHEREAS, the improvements of the Initial Project shall be extended onto the Block 21 Property, with the initial unit count and breakdown contemplated in the Initial Project increasing to include one hundred and ninety-three (193) units (inclusive of a superintendent's unit) in the Project and approximately 1,890 square feet of community facility space. Of the units, approximately forty-five (45) of the apartments are expected to receive a rental subsidy and social services funding from HPD (as defined herein) and the New York City Department of Social Services and approximately seventy-one (71) of the units are expected to receive rental Project and this extension collectively, the “Project"). 1
